chunks.subject: AP Physics C: Mechanics
chunks.title: Q3 Experimental Design and Analysis (LAB) — 10 points
chunks.content: AP Physics C: Mechanics FRQ 3 is Experimental Design and Analysis (LAB), 10 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The LAB task requires designing a procedure, planning a linearizing analysis, and reasoning from data/graphs. Q3 topic: a block-with-friction experiment (measuring friction coefficient, force, or acceleration). Points reward: a valid, replicable procedure with correct measurements and controls; a correct graphing/linearization plan; correct slope/intercept interpretation (tying it to friction/force); and data-supported conclusions. Common failure: a procedure missing a measurement/control; plotting quantities that do not linearize the relationship; not connecting slope/intercept to the physical quantity.

chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3A, 10/10
chunks.content: Q3 (LAB) scored 10/10 — complete procedure, correct linearizing plan, correct slope/intercept interpretation (e.g., slope → coefficient of friction), and data-supported conclusions. Full-credit model.

chunks.content: Q3 (LAB) scored 7/10 — earned most sub-points, losing a few on the linearization or the slope-to-quantity connection. Illustrates a strong lab design with a minor analysis gap.

chunks.subject: AP Physics C: Mechanics

chunks.content: Q3 (LAB) scored 4/10 — earned a few sub-points (part of the procedure and one analysis element), losing the linearization plan and most data-based reasoning. Illustrates a rough experiment without rigorous analysis.
